consequence.statement: Force promote actions for Numaplane rollouts are now available; no consequence for environments not using Numaplane rollouts, and the feature is additive to existing functionality.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds force promote actions for Numaplane rollouts.

decision.reason: [ev-acf625250e78] is a changelog entry under Features that only adds force promote actions for Numaplane rollouts. Nothing in it says that any existing behaviour, default, resource or setting changes, fails or is removed. An optional new action that nobody has to use has no operational consequence, so kind "none" (informational) fits. That "no consequence" is inferred from the feature being additive, because the entry does not state it outright.
